description: List the team's tasks in priority order. Filter by status (todo, in_progress, blocked, parked, done, cancelled, or delivered: handed in and waiting for its review), by assignee or by project (projects_list). To catch finished work, poll status done or delivered with since = the last time you looked.

assignee.description: Only tasks assigned to this agent.

project.description: Only tasks in this project (its key, from projects_list).

since.description: With status done, cancelled or delivered: only tasks that got there at or after this time (ISO 8601, UTC).

name: tasks_list
